label: Q01
question: Is knb-lter-cce.104 the correct EDI accession for this holding, or does it in fact describe the separate CCE-LTER POC/PON dataset, leaving the nitrate stable-isotope (delta-15N / delta-18O) dataset the CalOOS sheet names still unidentified?
context: CalOOS working sheet row 26 titles this holding "nitrate stable isotopes (N15/O18)" and gives knb-lter-cce.104 as its EDI accession, but EDI's own cite service (https://cite.edirepository.org/cite/knb-lter-cce.104.13?style=ESIP, checked 2026-09-05) titles knb-lter-cce.104 rev 13 "Particulate organic carbon and nitrogen measurements at selected depths in the water column in the CCE region since 2006 - ongoing" (Aluwihare) -- a POC/PON dataset, not a nitrate-isotope dataset. The nitrate stable-isotope dataset's own EDI accession is unconfirmed; dataset_meta.yml next_step already records this conflict.
